title: The Carpet Site (Domain Unknown)
style: lo-fi detective, male whispered narrator, female ghost backing, 80 BPM, dusty piano, brushed snare, vinyl crackle, mystery, missing-evidence, late-night-archive, neo-noir, magnifying-glass
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
There's a site that everybody's lost the name of by now
The carpet site they call it, the operator's sacred vow
Under the reseller account on the antipodean host
The domain name has vanished from every AI's ghost

[Pre-Chorus]
The carpet site, the carpet site, the domain unknown
Five months across the lanes, the recovery never grown

[Chorus]
The carpet site, the domain unknown
In the dashboard somewhere the answer has been thrown
The carpet site, the domain unknown
Login to the panel and let the truth be shown

[Verse 2]
Login VentraIP with brother's credentials in hand
List all sub-accounts and domains across the land
The carpet site is in there sitting in the list
Fuzzy search the disk before the typo gets dismissed

[Bridge]
Doctrine of two twenty five, decode the operator's voice
Don't invent unknown nouns, the typo's not the choice
Fuzzy search the disk before the brand goes invented
VentraIP signal recovered when the typo got cemented

[Outro]
The carpet site waits in the panel for the eye
One login away from joining the canonical sky
